messages:
alia: starting a brief follow-up thread for the StreamFade postmortem (timeouts + trailing partials). want clear owners + near-term rollback-safe changes.
jun: quick symptom recap: ~30-90s streams sometimes stop sending for a while, client reconnect resumes but final chunk is duplicated or dropped depending on timing. seen on prod routes /v1/stream and /v1/chat-stream.
marc: dug into worker traces: we see intermittent mid-assembly flush where the buffer is flushed before final commit. hypothesis: race between commit path and async writer flush. captured trace ids in trace:trace-8732.
nate: adding a sample log snippet we saw in prod: ```W 2026-04-02T17:22:10Z flush:assembly[id=aa3f] precommit=true size=0``` looks like precommit flag flips unexpectedly.
elena: I'll add a metric stream_fade.incident.count tagged by route/model and a counter for assembly_precommit. will wire alert: p99>5 in 10m -> page. ETA EOD.
sre-bot: created incident INC-2026-04-02-streamfade, owners set -> marc, jun.
alia: proposed triage plan (short): 1) add defensive flush coalescing on server (marc) 2) make client resume use monotonic seq + last-ack handshake (jun) 3) add replay driver test that simulates delayed flush and reconnect (katy) 4) metric + alert (elena) 5) 48h staged canary (alia). aim for minimal risk changes first.
marc: server plan: introduce flush_coalesce window = 150ms default, and a commit-token check to block flush if assembly not marked committed. will add feature flag for rollouts to Dedicated nodes. PR target Tue.
jun: client plan: add resume_offset in WS POST/upgrade, so server can return missing bytes and client dedupes by offset. will keep old behavior behind compatibility toggle. PR target Wed. also will add unit tests for duplicate-chunk handling.
katy: replay driver: will extend the replay tool to inject delays and mid-assembly flush events. test matrix: delay 50-500ms, concurrent reconnects. schedule first run in nightly on Mon.
elena: alert detail: emit 1m rate + 10m rate; create grafana panel and alert rule. temp notify channel -> #incidents until canary looks good.
alia: owners + deadlines recap: marc by 2026-04-06 (PR + NF), jun by 2026-04-07, katy by 2026-04-08 (tests in CI), elena by 2026-04-03 (metrics + paging rules), alia will coordinate canary plan by 2026-04-05.
marc: note about KV cache: flush semantics change could affect resume if we change sequence numbering. I'll add compatibility flag and test on dedicated nodes.
jun: ack. will design resume to tolerate old/new cache semantics; fall back to full-replay if resume fails.
katy: can we add a short acceptance checklist on each PR? proposed items: replay-driven regression pass, metric emitted, compatibility flag present, canary run passes.
alia: yes 12 I'll add a checklist template to the postmortem doc and link PRs there.
nate: small suggestion: add trace-id propagation to client reconnect path so we can match chunk -> attempt quickly in logs.
marc: agree, adding trace header X-Stream-Trace.
elena: pinging @qa-team to request a smoke run during canary, will coordinate times.
sre-bot: reminder scheduled: follow-up sync Fri 09:00 #incidents.
alia: post-fix follow-ups: if recurring patterns persist, we escalate INF-5410: "session-level rewind + circuit-breaker" for 2nd phase work.
marc: also including a lightweight unit that simulates delayed io in CI so regressions get caught in PRs.
jun: I'll publish a small compatibility note for SDKs and include resume vectors.
alia: final ask: everyone paste PR links here as they open, and update JIRA tasks INF-5401 (server), INF-5402 (client), INF-5403 (tests), INF-5404 (metrics). we'll keep this thread as the canonical follow-up. thanks all. :thumbsup:
